ModMetaData.name: Secular Colony – No Ideology for Your Colony (Works Mid-Save)
ModMetaData.author: Bolek98
ModMetaData.description:
Turn Ideology off for your colony – even in a running save. No belief moods, no conversions, no crisis of faith, no "ideoligion forbids". Other factions keep their beliefs, so you keep the rest of the DLC.
WHAT CHANGES FOR YOUR COLONY - No mood from beliefs: precepts, rituals, roles, ideoligion buildings, desired apparel and colours give neither bonus nor penalty. Existing ones disappear. - Certainty never drops; nobody converts your colonists and they don't preach to others. - "Ideoligion forbids" no longer blocks any job or action. - No mental breaks from beliefs (crisis of faith and similar) and no nagging belief alerts. - Partial mode: keep moods from rituals, roles, buildings or desired clothes if you like them. - Remove the ideoligion completely with one button – classic mode, no Ideoligion tab.
EXTRAS - Colonists now and then want a new hairstyle, beard or tattoo and visit a styling station by themselves; styles are free, not set by the ideoligion. Barber's table (Vanilla Hair Expanded) works too. - Relationships without belief: by traits (default), one partner for everyone, or free love. Two new traits, polyamorous and polygamous (RimJobWorld recognises them).
Every part can be switched on or off; switching off brings everything back. Requires Ideology and Harmony. Safe to add to or remove from a save.
Found a bug? Write it in the comments or use the "Report a bug" button (bottom left in the mod settings) – a short report for a Workshop comment, the full one for GitHub Issues.
简体中文：为你的殖民地关闭文化体系——存档中途也可以。没有信仰心情、没有改信、没有信仰危机，"文化禁止"不再阻止任何工作。其他派系保留信仰。
Русский: отключает идеологию для вашей колонии – даже в текущем сохранении. Никаких настроений от верований, обращений, кризисов веры и запретов «идеология запрещает». Другие фракции сохраняют свои верования.
한국어: 정착지의 이념을 끕니다 – 진행 중인 세이브에서도 가능. 신념으로 인한 기분, 개종, 신앙의 위기, "이념이 금지함" 제한이 없습니다. 다른 세력은 신념을 유지합니다.
日本語：入植地のイデオロギーをオフにします（進行中のセーブでも可）。信念による気分、改宗、信仰の危機、「イデオロギーが禁じている」がなくなります。他の勢力は信念を保ちます。
Deutsch: Schaltet die Ideologie für deine Kolonie aus – auch in einem laufenden Spielstand. Keine Glaubens-Stimmungen, keine Bekehrungen, keine Glaubenskrise, kein „Ideologie verbietet“. Andere Fraktionen behalten ihren Glauben.
Português: desliga a ideologia da sua colônia – até em um save em andamento. Sem humor de crenças, sem conversões, sem crise de fé, sem "a ideologia proíbe". Outras facções mantêm suas crenças.
Español: desactiva la ideología de tu colonia, incluso en una partida empezada. Sin estados de ánimo por creencias, sin conversiones, sin crisis de fe, sin "la ideología lo prohíbe". Las demás facciones conservan sus creencias.
Čeština: vypne ideologii pro tvou kolonii – i v rozehrané hře. Žádné nálady z víry, převádění, krize víry ani „ideologie zakazuje“. Ostatní frakce si víru nechají. Navíc: kolonisté si sami mění účes a tetování, vztahy bez víry (podle vlastností, jeden partner nebo volná láska) a částečný režim. Každou část lze vypnout. Chyby piš do komentářů nebo použij tlačítko „Nahlásit chybu“ vlevo dole v nastavení.
